title: Kuroko keybinds.toml
description: Every hotkey of Kuroko (%APPDATA%\Kuroko\keybinds.toml). Mirrors src/Kuroko.Core/Config/KeybindsLoader.cs; the app itself reports errors with file and line, also for hotkeys used twice, plain Ctrl+C/A/V and prompt names that prompts.toml does not have. See docs/keybindings.md.

mods.description: Modifier variables: a name for a modifier combination, used in every hotkey of this file as $name (main = "Ctrl" makes "$main+Alt+K" Ctrl+Alt+K). Names: letters, digits and _, not case-sensitive. Values: modifiers only (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win), no key and no other variable.

app.description: The app's own hotkeys. A missing one keeps its default.

undo.description: Undoes the last replacement (press again to go further back). Only active while undo_history in settings.toml is above 0.

result_copy.description: Copies the whole text of the result card and closes it. Also copies the finished answer while the error pill of a failed paste is shown. Only registered while one of them is visible.

prompts.description: Prompt hotkeys: the name of a prompt in prompts.toml (not case-sensitive) = its hotkey, which runs the prompt directly. "" = no hotkey. A name prompts.toml does not have is an error.

submaps.description: One [submaps.<name>] block per submap: its open hotkey shows the label in the pill and, for timeout milliseconds, makes each listed key a hotkey of its own without modifiers. Names: letters, digits, _ and -.

programs.description: One [programs.<name>] block per program: what to start, optionally its arguments, working folder and hotkey. A submap key "@name" starts it too. Names: letters, digits, _ and -, not case-sensitive.

hotkey.description: Modifiers Ctrl (Control, Strg), Alt, Shift (Umschalt), Win (Windows) joined with + and one key: A-Z, 0-9, F1-F24; a name (Space, Enter, Tab, Esc, Backspace, Insert, Delete, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, Left, Up, Right, Down, Num0-Num9, NumAdd, NumSubtract, NumMultiply, NumDivide, NumDecimal, Oem1-Oem8, Oem102, OemPlus, OemComma, OemMinus, OemPeriod, Plus, PrintScreen, Pause, ScrollLock, CapsLock, NumLock, Menu, media, volume and browser keys); a key code 0x01-0xFE (Ctrl+Alt+0xE2); or the character printed on the key in the active keyboard layout (Ctrl+Alt+ü, Ctrl+Alt+<, Ctrl+Alt++). Only the key's own character counts: characters typed with Shift or AltGr (> | °) are an error. At least one modifier unless the key is F1-F24. Not plain Ctrl+C, Ctrl+A or Ctrl+V. A variable from [mods] stands for its modifiers: "$card+S", "$main+Alt+K".

open.description: Hotkey that opens the submap; pressed again while it is open, it closes it. Counts in the check for hotkeys used twice.

label.description: Text the pill shows while the submap is open; line breaks (\n or a """multi-line""" string) are kept. Without a label the pill lists the keys, one per line: key and target.

timeout.description: Milliseconds the submap stays open without a key. Esc closes it earlier.

keys.description: Key = what it runs. The key is written alone, without modifiers: a letter, digit, F-key, name (Space, Num5), code (0xE2) or the character on the key ("<", "ü"); not Esc. The target is a prompt name from prompts.toml, a program from [programs] with an @ ("@firefox") or a command with a slash: /undo, /copy, /prompts, /settings, /keybinds, /folder, /reload, /keys, /test, /autostart, /about, /quit.

run.description: What to start: the absolute path to an .exe or .lnk ('C:\Program Files\App\app.exe'), a program name with .exe and no folder ("wt.exe", looked up by Windows as Win+R does: App Paths, PATH) or a Store app as shell:AppsFolder\<AppID> (find the AppID with Get-StartApps). %VARIABLES% are replaced. Scripts (.bat, .cmd, .ps1, .vbs) are not supported in this test build. No shell, no admin rights.

args.description: Arguments, one text per argument, passed on exactly as written (no %VARIABLES%, no shell). Not allowed with shell:AppsFolder.

dir.description: Absolute working folder; %VARIABLES% are replaced. Default: the folder of an .exe given by path, otherwise the user's profile folder.

hotkey.description: Hotkey that starts the program; "" or left out = only through a submap key "@name". Counts in the check for hotkeys used twice.
